theorems.name: Submission.gwe_weighted_energy_weak_equation
theorems.statement: ∀ n ℓ : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∀ K0 cJ : ℝ, 0 ≤ K0 → 0 ≤ cJ → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (σ κ E h : ℝ) (f : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (W : Rn n → ℝ), 0 < σ → 0 ≤ κ → κ ≤ 1 → 0 ≤ E → 0 ≤ h → LipschitzOnWith 1 f (closedBall 0 (σ / 2)) → Measurable W → (∀ᵐ x ∂(volume : Measure (Rn n)), x ∈ ball 0 (3 * σ / 8) → W x = 0 ∨ (1 ≤ W x ∧ W x ≤ (1 + κ) * (1 + cJ * hsNormSq (fderiv ℝ f x)))) → volume (ball (0 : Rn n) (3 * σ / 8) ∩ {x | W x = 0}) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (K0 * E * σ ^ n) → ∫⁻ x in ball (0 : Rn n) (3 * σ / 8), ENNReal.ofReal (hsNormSq (fderiv ℝ f x) * W x) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (K0 * E * σ ^ n) → (∫ x in ball (0 : Rn n) (3 * σ / 8), hsNormSq (fderiv ℝ f x) ≤ C * E * σ ^ n) ∧ ∀ ζ : Rn n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ ball 0 (σ / 4) → ∀ M : ℝ, (∀ x, ‖gradient ζ x‖ ≤ M) → ∀ j : Fin ℓ, |∫ x in ball (0 : Rn n) (σ / 4), inner ℝ (gradient (fun y => f y j) x) (gradient ζ x) * W x| ≤ K0 * (E + h) * M * σ ^ n → |∫ x in ball (0 : Rn n) (σ / 4), inner ℝ (gradient (fun y => f y j) x) (gradient ζ x)| ≤ C * (E + h + κ * Real.sqrt E) * M * σ ^ n
